name: Medi Mentor VR
summary:
Step into realistic clinical scenarios with Medi Mentor, an immersive VR training experience designed to help healthcare learners build confidence before it counts. Practice patient communication, clinical observation, medication management, and decision-making in a safe virtual environment where every choice becomes an opportunity to learn.
